question: In which year was the Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) incorporated?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1907.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO)** was incorporated in **1907** by **Jamsetji Tata.**
 
• TISCO was established in **Jamshedpur, Jharkhand**, and is one of the largest steel-producing companies in India.
 
• It was the first privately owned steel company in India and laid the foundation for India’s modern industrial development.
 
• In 2005, TISCO was renamed as **Tata Steel Limited** to reflect its global expansion and modernization.
 
• Tata Steel is known for its innovations in the steel industry, focusing on sustainability, advanced technology, and social responsibility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamsetji Tata**:

 
 
• Jamsetji Tata, often called the "Father of Indian Industry," was the visionary behind the establishment of TISCO, which aimed to make India self-reliant in steel production.
 
 
 
• **Jamshedpur**:
 
 
• The city of Jamshedpur was named after Jamsetji Tata and is often referred to as the "Steel City" of India due to its significant industrial base centered around Tata Steel.
 
 
 
• **Indian Steel Industry**:
 
 
• India is now the second-largest steel producer in the world, and Tata Steel plays a pivotal role in the country's steel industry, both domestically and globally.
 
 
 
• **Tata Group**:
 
 
• Tata Steel is part of the Tata Group, one of India's largest and most respected business conglomerates, with interests in various sectors like automobiles, telecommunications, and hospitality.
